evidence_against.relevance: Casey initiated contact most weeks and consistently arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner show effort and responsiveness to Drew's priorities.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods apart, indicating sustained interest rather than purely passive involvement.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting the question, supporting low commitment.
The location and short notice of most meetings, plus two cancellations for other commitments, suggest involvement structured around Casey's convenience.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Because Casey shows sustained interest but avoids definition and longer-term planning, Drew should directly clarify desired commitment and whether or when the relationship can be revisited.

uncertainty_explanation: The record shows genuine ongoing interest and some meaningful effort, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience pattern, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement than meaningful commitment.
